nusmp.page.book_black_oil.tar_pit: The ground turns to a pit of tar. A zone (radius 5, 8 seconds) at the aim point holds every enemy in Slowness IV, soaked in oil, dragged toward its centre and pushed down so they cannot jump, and deals 2 damage every half second.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.curse_candle_r: A ritual disk is drawn at your feet and six black candles are lit around it. For 12 seconds every enemy inside (radius 6) takes 2.5 curse damage a second, Weakness, Slowness, Fragility and a drain of magicule, and each cursed enemy (up to 3) feeds you 1 health a second while you stand inside.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.black_oil_erup: A well of black oil bursts from the ground, and then it catches. At the aim point enemies within 6 blocks take 12 damage, are thrown into the air (bosses barely) and left soaked and in Slowness IV; two seconds later the geyser ignites for 18 fire damage (half again as much for the oil), burning for 8 seconds, followed by 3 seconds of flames on the ground that deal 3 fire damage every half second.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.black_oil_sea: Once a day, the oil rises into a lake around you. For 15 seconds everything within 11 blocks of where you stood is in Slowness III and soaked in oil and takes 2 damage a second, while you and your allies skate over it with Speed II and Resistance.
nusmp.page.book_body.bullet_fist: The legs coil and let go, and the whole body is the bullet. Nothing in the way keeps its footing. You lunge about 7 blocks forward in 7 ticks; each foe you pass takes 8 damage (35% of its armour ignored), is shoved back and lifted, and is slowed (Slowness II, 1.5 s). You take no fall damage while lunging.
nusmp.page.book_body.rapid_barrage: Five fists in under a second, all into the same few places that hurt. The first four are only a warning. Needs a target within 6 blocks: five jabs, one every 3 ticks, four of 2.8 damage and a last one of 6 (40% of armour ignored, ignores the hit-immunity of the earlier jabs); the last jab knocks the foe back and gives it Weakness for 4 s (1.5 s on bosses).
nusmp.page.book_body.body_compression: The forearm is condensed and restructured from the inside until it is a gun barrel, and what the mage feeds into it leaves faster than the eye can follow. After a 6 tick forming, three piercing rounds fly 4 ticks apart (34 blocks, 6.5 damage each, the last packed double for 11 and a heavy knockback); each shot kicks you slightly back.
nusmp.page.book_body.tendon_sever: A thumb pressed in the right place and the leg simply stops listening. Armour does not matter to a tendon. Needs a target within 8 blocks and uses the shared control lock: 5 damage (60% of armour ignored), Slowness VI, Weakness II and Mining Fatigue II for up to 3.5 s (1 s on bosses) and a 4% bleed of the foe's magicules.
nusmp.page.book_body.hardened_frame: Bone is packed tighter, muscle is drawn like cable, and blows begin to ring off the body rather than into it. Costs Aura (8%) on top of the page: for 20 s physical damage you take is cut by 30% and magic damage by 15%, you gain Absorption II (4 hearts), and the muscle layer of Body Magic shows on your skin.
nusmp.page.book_body.tissue_mend: Flesh is only a habit the body keeps; call it back and it knits. Wounds close, burns cool, poison runs out. You and every ally within 5 blocks heal 25% of max health (the usual healing decay applies), gain Regeneration II for 8 s, are put out and lose every harmful potion effect.
nusmp.page.book_body.leg_spring: Legs wound like a spring, then released. The ground takes the weight when you come back down. Costs Aura (4%): you leap about 8 blocks high and 5 forward, take no fall damage, and on landing everything within 4.2 blocks takes 9 damage, is shoved away and lifted, and is slowed (Slowness II, 2 s).
nusmp.page.book_body.quake_stomp: One heavy step, and the earth answers in rings, each one breaking the ground a little farther out. The stomp sends five shock waves outward over 15 ticks to 6 blocks (scales with mana zone); every foe the wave reaches once takes 7 damage, is thrown outward and up, slowed (Slowness III, 3 s) and dizzied (Nausea, 3 s; 1 s on bosses).
nusmp.page.book_body.titan_form: Every muscle in the body is condensed and then released at once, and the mage stands a head taller with steam pouring off the skin. Costs Aura (15%): for 20 s you gain Strength II, Resistance II and 6 extra hearts; melee blows deal +6 damage and shake every foe within 2.5 blocks of the target for 3 and a shove. The cast itself throws foes within 4 blocks back for 6 damage. When the form ends you are slowed (Slowness II) and weakened for 4 s.
nusmp.page.book_body.flesh_regrowth: Even a lost limb is only tissue that has not yet been told to grow. The body is made to remember what it was. Once a day: you heal half of your max health at once, then Regeneration III for 12 s and Absorption III; allies within 8 blocks heal 30% with Regeneration II and Absorption II. Everyone touched loses every harmful potion effect and is put out. Once a day.
nusmp.page.book_briar.thorn_lash: A vine grows from your hand and cracks like a whip, hooking its prickles into flesh and dragging the victim in. Hits everything within 8 blocks in a line for 6 damage, poisons for 3 seconds, cuts a little of the target's magicules and yanks it toward you (not bosses).
nusmp.page.book_briar.creeping_vines: The ground where you point splits and wild vines crawl up legs. A 3.2 block patch pulses twice, one second apart: 3 damage, Slowness V with the stride cut, and poison, on everything in it. Bosses are slowed less.
nusmp.page.book_briar.bleeding_thorn_wal: A hedge of briar roots erupts in front of you, red with the blood of those who tested it. Raises a 7 wide, 3 high wall for 11 seconds, throws back and wounds the enemies nearby (3 damage, poison), then every half second tears anyone touching it for 1.5 damage, poison, Slowness II and a cut in their magicules.
nusmp.page.book_briar.rose_scent: The roses breathe a sweet perfume that dulls every sense. Within 7 blocks, enemies get Blindness for 4 seconds, Nausea for 5, Weakness for 6 and Magic Jamming for 5 seconds. On bosses these last about a third as long.
nusmp.page.book_briar.thorn_reflect: A dress of briars grows over you, and whoever strikes it is pricked in turn. For 20 seconds you gain Resistance, take 15 percent less from every enemy blow, and each attacker takes 40 percent of that blow as thorn damage (at most 8) and is poisoned for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_briar.briar_leap: You throw a vine at the point you look at and let it haul you across. Launches you up to 22 blocks toward the aim point with Slow Falling, snares enemies at your feet (4 damage, rooted) and bursts into thorns where you land (5 damage, poison, rooted for 1.5 seconds in 3 blocks).
nusmp.page.book_briar.briar_garden: A wild thicket of roses blooms where you look, beautiful and merciless. A 5.5 block field lasts 10 seconds and every half second deals 1.5 damage, poison and Slowness III to enemies inside, cutting their magicules every second.
nusmp.page.book_briar.corpse_hunting_bri: You unsheathe your weapon and it becomes prickle-covered vines that hunt your targets across the field. They seize up to 4 of the nearest enemies within 20 blocks, rooting them (Slowness X, held about 3 seconds, shortened on bosses), then converge into a tall briar tree that rises through them for 14 damage and a toss, followed by 2.5 damage, poison and a magicule cut every half second for 2.5 seconds. Needs the control lock.
nusmp.page.book_briar.queen_of_briars: A natural mana array blooms real roses and you wrap yourself in a dress and crown of briars, red roses on the left, blue on the right, a whip in your hand. For 60 seconds you gain Resistance, Regeneration and thorn reflect, and your melee hits add 3 damage, poison and a magicule drain. On cast the whip lashes enemies within 8 blocks: red roses deal 8 damage, poison and a bleed; the strongest of them is wrapped in blue roses that hold harder the greater its power (Slowness and Weakness, drained). Needs the control lock when enemies are near.
nusmp.page.book_briar.rose_garden_bloom: Once a day the land around you remembers it was a wilderness and blooms into a briar field. For 20 seconds, within 9 blocks, enemies take 3 damage, poison, root and Magic Jamming every second and lose magicules to you, while you and your allies heal 3 percent of their health each second.
nusmp.page.book_copper.conduction_arc: Conduction Arc - copper carries a charge from one body to the next, and the mage only has to touch the first. Hits the foe you look at (18 blocks) for 7 damage (scaled by EP), then jumps to the nearest other foe within 6 blocks, up to 5 foes in all, each jump 15% weaker. Every foe hit is slowed (Slowness II, 2 s) and has its magic jammed (Magic Jamming, 1.5 s).
nusmp.page.book_copper.red_shine_mace: Red Shine Mace - the mage draws a huge polearm out of glowing copper, its head the size of an anvil, and brings it down on the enemy. The mace lands after half a second on the target (or the aim point, 14 blocks): every foe within 3.2 blocks takes 14 damage (scaled by EP) with half of their armour ignored, is knocked back, slowed (Slowness III, 3 s), weakened (Weakness, 4 s) and made to glow (4 s).
nusmp.page.book_copper.copper_wire_bind: Copper Wire Bind - thin copper wire flies from the fingertips and wraps limbs tighter than rope, and it is as good a conductor as it is a binder. Binds the foe you look at (16 blocks) and up to two more within 4.5 blocks of it: they cannot move (Slowness X, 2.5 s, shorter on repeat and on bosses), take 4 damage (scaled by EP) and lose 2% of their magicules. Hard control: shares the 12 s control lock.
nusmp.page.book_copper.verdigris_blight: Verdigris Blight - the mage lets the copper age in a heartbeat, and green rust creeps over whatever it touches. At the aim point (16 blocks) a 4.5 block field bursts for 5 damage (scaled by EP) and pulses once a second for 4 s for 2.5 each; foes inside are poisoned (3 s), corroded (Corrosion, 5 s) and made fragile (Fragility, 5 s), so their armour and resistance give way. Bosses keep the effects for a third of the time.
nusmp.page.book_copper.rail_dash: Rail Dash - a strip of copper unrolls under the mage's feet and the current carries them along it. Dashes up to 11 blocks forward, shocking everything on the line for 6 damage (scaled by EP), knocking it aside, slowing it (Slowness II, 1.5 s) and jamming its magic (1.5 s). Afterwards you keep Speed II for 3 s.
nusmp.page.book_copper.galvanic_edge: Galvanic Edge - the mage's weapon and fists hum with stored charge, and every blow lets some of it run free. For 15 s your melee hits deal 4 extra damage (scaled by EP), and each hit arcs 4 damage (scaled by EP) to the nearest other foe within 5 blocks, slowing it (1.5 s). You also gain Haste I for the duration.
nusmp.page.book_copper.copper_plating: Copper Plating - plates of copper grow over skin and cloth, each one welded to the next. For 15 s all physical damage you take is cut by a third (magic is not), you gain 4 hearts of Absorption, and every attacker that strikes you is shocked for 3 damage and slowed (1 s).
nusmp.page.book_copper.copper_bulwark: Copper Bulwark - a wall of cut copper rises out of the ground, still warm and humming. Raises a wall five blocks wide and three high, 2.5 blocks in front of you, for 10 s (only on free space; it is removed afterwards). Foes within 3.4 blocks of it are shocked every second for 2.5 damage (scaled by EP) and slowed (Slowness II, 2 s).
nusmp.page.book_copper.conduction_field: Conduction Field - the ground turns to a plate of live copper, and anything standing on it becomes part of the circuit. At the aim point (20 blocks) a field of 5.5 blocks radius lasts 6 s; every second it shocks up to 8 foes inside for 3.5 damage (scaled by EP), slows them (Slowness II, 1.5 s) and, on every second pulse, jams their magic (2 s). Lines of current visibly link the foes together.
nusmp.page.book_copper.copper_tempest: Copper Tempest - a single rod of copper is driven into the earth, and the sky answers it three times. At the aim point (22 blocks) a rod stands for 5 s: foes within 7 blocks are dragged toward it, and at 2 s, 3 s and 4 s a bolt falls for 13 damage (scaled by EP) to up to 10 foes, slowing (Slowness III, 2 s) and jamming their magic (4 s), with current running from the rod to each. The last bolt paralyses (about 2 s, hard control, shorter on bosses).
nusmp.page.book_copper.plating_restorati: Plating Restoration - the mage beats the dented plates flat again and polishes them bright. Once a day: you and allies within 8 blocks heal 30% of maximum health (healing decay applies), gain 6 hearts of Absorption for 20 s and are cleansed of poison and wither, and your own Copper Plating is renewed for 15 s.
nusmp.page.book_eye.piercing_glance: Nothing hides from a glance that has already decided where to land. Strikes the first target in sight within 28 blocks for 7 damage and makes it glow for 5 seconds; an invisible target is revealed and takes 50% more (10.5). Damage scales with Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_eye.seeker_eyes: Four small eyes slip out of the grimoire and follow the magic of whoever is nearest. Each flies at speed 1.25, homes on the closest enemies within 16 blocks and hits for 5 damage, blinds for 2 seconds and bleeds 1% of the target's magicules. Damage scales with Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_eye.mark_of_sight: A mark burned into the sight of the world: the target can no longer be lost. Marks one target within 32 blocks for 12 seconds: it glows through walls, loses invisibility and takes 25% more damage from you and your allies. Deals 2 damage on cast.
nusmp.page.book_eye.blinding_flash: The eyes open wide and the light inside them is too much to look at. Everyone in front of you within 9 blocks takes 4 damage and is blinded for 6 seconds (bosses 1.5 seconds), and monsters lose their target on you. Needs at least one enemy in the cone. Damage scales with Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_eye.evil_eye: A long look that takes more than it shows. One target within 24 blocks takes 4 damage, Weakness II for 12 seconds, Slowness and Mining Fatigue for 6 seconds and Fragility (lower resistance) for 6 seconds, and you drink 5% of its magicules (1% from bosses).
nusmp.page.book_eye.keen_sight: Sharpen the eyes until the dark is only another colour. For 30 seconds you gain Night Vision and Speed, and your melee hits deal 3 extra damage scaled by Existence Points.
nusmp.page.book_eye.iris_ward: A wide iris opens around the mage and shows every shot its own aim. For 8 seconds enemy projectiles that enter 4.5 blocks around you (up to 14) are turned back at whoever fired them and become yours, and that shooter is jammed (Magic Jamming) for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eye.sight_step: Where the eyes can see, the body can already stand. Teleports you to the spot you are looking at, up to 16 blocks away and never through a wall, resets fall damage and gives Night Vision for 5 seconds. Up to 8 enemies along the path are revealed and glow for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eye.field_of_eyes: The ground opens a hundred lidless eyes, and none of them blink. A 6 block zone at the target point lasting 8 seconds: every 0.5 seconds up to 12 enemies inside take 1.5 damage, glow, get Weakness, are jammed (Magic Jamming) and lose 0.5% of their magicules. Invisible enemies are revealed.
nusmp.page.book_eye.reflect_iris: Union Magic: an array of mirrors turns round the mage, and anyone who looks into it sees their own eyes looking back. For 6 seconds, up to 8 enemies within 8 blocks who look at you are paralysed for up to 2.5 seconds (bosses 1 second) with their magic blocked for 3 seconds longer, then struck by Reflect Refrain for 14 damage scaled by Existence Points. Uses the shared control lock.
nusmp.page.book_eye.all_seeing_eye: The mage opens the eye that never closes and the whole country lies open. For 30 seconds you have Night Vision, everything alive within 40 blocks glows through walls (invisible ones too), and up to 40 are tracked. Foes within 20 blocks stay marked and take 25% more from you and your allies. Daily: 10 minute cooldown.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.sniper_eye: One eye hangs far ahead, watching the muscles of the prey, and fires when the step is already decided. Hits the first target within 40 blocks instantly for 8 damage, or 12 if it is moving or falling, and slows it (Slowness I) for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.roving_eyes: Four small eyes slip from the grimoire and wander after the nearest enemies. Fires 4 homing eyes that deal 5 damage each on hit and apply Slowness II for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.petrifying_gaze: A stare that does not blink turns the blood to stone. The first target within 22 blocks takes 3 damage and is paralysed for up to 3.5 seconds, with Slowness X, no jumping and Mining Fatigue for 2 more seconds. Hard control: shares the 12 second control lock, shortened by repeats, a quarter on bosses.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.magicule_scan: The eyes spread out like a net and read every magicule signature around you. Every enemy within 20 blocks (up to 16) glows through walls for 10 seconds and loses 3 percent of its magicules (0.5 percent on bosses). You gain Night Vision for 12 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.eye_swap: You see through the eye on the enemy, and for a breath that is where you stand. You and the target within 20 blocks trade places; it takes 2 damage, is blinded for 2 seconds, slowed (Slowness II) for 3 seconds and forgets its aim. Fails without room on both sides and never works on bosses.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.sight_share: Your eyes become everyone's eyes. You and allies within 16 blocks (up to 8) gain Night Vision for 60 seconds and Speed I for 30 seconds, and every enemy within 30 blocks glows for 10 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.guardian_eyes: Eyes circle you, blinking, and nothing slips past them. For 10 seconds enemy projectiles and spells entering 4 blocks are shot down (up to 24), you gain Resistance I, and enemies near you are slowed (Slowness II) every half second.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.scouting_eyes: You leave eyes in the air and walk away, still watching through them. For 25 seconds a 14 block circle at your aim point makes every enemy inside glow and be weakened (Weakness I), and gives allies inside Night Vision.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.jamming_gaze_fie: A great eye opens above a circle of ground and nothing under it may cast. For 10 seconds, every half second, enemies within 6 blocks (up to 12) take 2 damage and Slowness III; those the eye can see (no wall between) are also silenced and have their Ultimate skills jammed. Break line of sight to avoid the jamming.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.catoblepas_s_evi: Eyes spread over the whole field and the prey is read: its magic, its stamina, its next step. For 10 seconds, every second the 5 nearest enemies within 20 blocks are revealed and sniped for 5 damage (7.5 if moving), slowed (Slowness II) and bled of 1 percent of their magicules. On the last pulse they are paralysed for up to 2.5 seconds. Hard control: shares the 12 second control lock. You gain Night Vision.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.swarm_of_eyes: A cloud of tiny eyes flies around you, and each one finds a victim. For 12 seconds, five times a second, one eye picks a random enemy within 22 blocks for 3 damage and Slowness I. Once a day.
nusmp.page.book_food.fork_skewer: A fork as tall as a doorway, thrown point first. It pierces every enemy in a line (9 damage, range about 29 blocks) and leaves each one bleeding magicules (5% of their pool), while the first three skewered feed you 1.5 health each.
nusmp.page.book_food.carving_cleave: A carving knife the size of a plank sweeps across the table and everything on it. Enemies in a wide cone 5 blocks long take 12 damage, bleed 4% of their magicules, are knocked back and suffer Weakness for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_food.pie_barrage: Five pies fly out one after another, each one aimed at a different face. Every pie homes on the nearest enemies for 5 damage, covers them in cream (Slowness II for 3 seconds) and blinds non-boss targets for 1 second.
nusmp.page.book_food.rotten_feast: Leftovers forgotten for a month, served with a smile. A spoiled dish (6 damage) bursts where it lands into a stinking cloud of radius 3.2 that lasts 4 seconds: every enemy inside takes 2.5 damage every half second and is given Hunger III, Poison II, Weakness and, unless it is a boss, nausea.
nusmp.page.book_food.starving_rush: The hungry mage lunges across the room straight for the plate. Dashes up to 9 blocks forward, biting every enemy on the way for 8 damage and recovering 2 health for each one hit.
nusmp.page.book_food.hearty_meal: A hot plate set in front of every friend at the table. You and your allies within 8 blocks recover 25% of their maximum health, are fed (8 food points), regain 4% of their magicules and gain Regeneration for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_food.full_stomach: A full belly is the best armour there is. For 30 seconds you gain Strength, Resistance and Absorption III, your food bar is filled, and 60% of the damage of every projectile that hits you is eaten, healing you for half of what was eaten. Allies within 5 blocks share half the duration with weaker Absorption.
nusmp.page.book_food.silver_platter: A great silver dish lifted in front of the mage, to catch whatever is thrown. For 5 seconds every enemy projectile and spell shot that enters 3.4 blocks of you is eaten, healing you 2 health and restoring 3% of your magicules each (up to 6 per half second), and you gain Absorption II.
nusmp.page.book_food.banquet_table: A long table unrolls across the ground, laden to the edges. For 8 seconds, once a second, you and your allies inside the 5 block circle recover 4% of their health, are fed and regain 1.5% of their magicules, while enemies in the circle are stuffed and sluggish (Slowness and Weakness).
nusmp.page.book_food.glutton_s_banquet: With the grimoire open, a giant wolf rises with a fork and a knife, stabbing the spells in the air and dragging them into its mouth. For about 3 seconds a feeding zone of radius 5.5 eats every enemy projectile (5% of your magicules and 2 health each) and breaks enemy magic constructs, then the wolf bites: enemies within 4.5 blocks take 14 damage and lose 12% of their magicules to you, you heal 3 per victim, and every spell eaten adds Absorption for 20 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_food.midnight_feast: When the house is asleep, the grimoire sets one last, impossible feast. Once a day: you and allies within 12 blocks have hunger, poison and nausea washed away, recover 50% of their health and are fed to the brim, regain 25% of their magicules and gain Regeneration for 10 seconds, and Absorption III and Strength for 30 seconds, then a second helping 3 seconds later heals 20% more.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.spore_burst: A swollen puffball, lobbed and left to split open. It flies up to 24 blocks and bursts on contact in a 2.6 block cloud: 5 damage and Poison for 5 seconds, then the cloud lingers 3 seconds, re-poisoning, weakening and siphoning a little magicule from everyone inside.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.mycelium_roots: White threads race through the soil ahead of you and snag every ankle in their way. A 10 block row of roots deals 3 damage, then holds those caught in Slowness IV for 4 seconds, re-applied for 3 seconds while the roots hold; bosses are only slowed lightly.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.heavy_mr_mushroom: You press spores onto the target, and a tired old mushroom sprouts on it and keeps growing, heavier by the second. After 1 second the target is slowed more every quarter second, up to Slowness X, dragged to the ground and left mining-fatigued, then crushed for 12 damage when the pin ends (up to 4.5 seconds, shorter on players, repeats and bosses). Hard control: shares the control cooldown.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.running_mr_mushro: A little mushroom with surprisingly good legs, carrying you ahead of the spores. You dash up to 9 blocks forward, dealing 5 damage, Poison and Slowness to everything on the way, gain Speed II for 6 seconds, and leave a mycelium trail that re-poisons and slows anything crossing it for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.talking_mr_mushro: The mushroom never stops talking, and for once that helps: it knows who is hiding where and where each of them is soft. Every enemy within 22 blocks (up to 16) is outlined with Glowing for 10 seconds and gains Fragility for 5 seconds, and you are told how many there are and how far the closest is.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.spore_armor: A thick coat of fine spores clings to you and sprouts back at anything that touches it. For 20 seconds you gain Resistance and take 15 percent less from melee attackers, who are poisoned and weakened (Poison II for 5 seconds), and your own melee hits poison for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.mushroom_wall: Giant stems and caps burst from the ground in a line, thick enough to stop a charge. A five wide, three tall wall of mushroom blocks stands for 10 seconds in front of you; enemies near it are shoved back and poisoned for 3 seconds. Blocks never grow around someone standing in the way.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.mycelium_mending: The same threads that bind can stitch: mycelium knits flesh and draws out poison. You and your allies within 7 blocks heal 18 percent of maximum health (the usual healing decay applies), gain Regeneration for 5 seconds and are cured of Poison.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.spore_cloud: A great grey-brown cloud rolls out and does not lift for a long time. At the aimed point (up to 20 blocks) a 5 block cloud lasts 8 seconds: every half second it deals 1.5 damage and applies Poison II and Weakness, and every second it siphons 1 percent of each victim's magicules into you.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.towering_mr_mushr: Open the grimoire and the ground swells: a giant king oyster with arms, legs and a face rises and does not look pleased. After 1.2 seconds it erupts at the aimed point (up to 24 blocks), dealing 16 damage in 3.5 blocks, throwing enemies up, poisoning them and rooting them; for 6 seconds its arms slam everything within 4.5 blocks every second for 6 damage, a shove, Poison II and a 1 percent magicule siphon, while a tall stem and cap of mushroom blocks stands for 7 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.mycelium_bloom: Once a day the whole forest floor remembers it is alive. For 20 seconds a 9 block fungal forest blooms around where you stand: every second enemies take 3 damage, Poison II, Weakness and Slowness III and lose 2 percent of their magicules to you, while allies inside heal 3 percent of maximum health. Usable once per in-game day.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_bullet: The mage wraps a large iron casing round one arm and thrusts it at the target; mana tears it loose and it explodes on contact. Flies up to 16 blocks, then bursts in a 2.5 block radius for 10 damage, knocks enemies back and weighs them down (Slowness II and Burden) for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_shrapnel: A fist of iron is shattered in the grimoire's face and the pieces fly like a shotgun blast. Hits every enemy in a 7 block cone for 6 damage; the splinters slow them (Slowness II) for 2 seconds and bleed 1.5 percent of their magicules.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_sword_rain: Iron swords hang over the field, then fall one after another like a hard rain. Eight blades drop at random points within 4 blocks of the aimed spot (up to 22 blocks), each hitting everything within 1.8 blocks for 6 damage and slowing it (Slowness II) for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_shackles: Iron cuffs close round the wrists and ankles of the target, heavy enough to pin a giant. The target within 16 blocks takes 5 damage, is rooted (Slowness X), weighed down (Burden II) and Weakened for up to 4.5 seconds (players 3 s, bosses 1 s). Uses the shared control lock.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_charge: The mage becomes a cannonball of iron and goes straight through whatever is in the way. Dashes up to 9 blocks forward, hitting everything on the path for 8 damage, knocking it aside and weighing it down (Slowness II and Burden) for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_fist: Iron grows over the knuckles until each punch lands like a forge hammer. For 20 seconds your melee hits deal 4 extra damage and you gain Resistance I.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_wall: A slab of solid iron rises in front of the mage, as wide as a doorway and thrice as tall as it needs to be. Raises a wall of iron blocks four wide and three high 2.5 blocks ahead, which sinks back into the ground after 8 seconds. Only fills empty space.
nusmp.page.book_iron.immovable_guardian_: A great metal bell, its outside carved with a guardian figure, comes down over the mage and nothing gets in. For 8 seconds you and your allies within 3.5 blocks gain Resistance III, you gain Absorption II (and Slowness I as the price of standing still), enemy projectiles in the bell are destroyed, and enemies touching it are shoved away and take 2 damage each second. Like the original it is not a defence against spatial magic.
nusmp.page.book_iron.rust_field: Iron that is left alone rots, and the mage speeds it up a thousandfold. For 7 seconds every enemy within 5 blocks of the aimed point (up to 20 blocks) is slowed (Slowness II), Weakened, weighed down (Burden) and its defences corrode (Fragility, where Tensura has it); each second it takes 3 damage and loses 1 percent of its magicules.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_god_of_war: The mage is sheathed in the iron body of a war god taller than any gate, and the ground trembles at each step. At the cast a slam hits everything within 6 blocks for 14 damage and slows it. For 12 seconds you gain Resistance III, Strength II and Absorption III, and every second your stomp hits all enemies within 5 blocks for 5 damage, slows them (Slowness III) and throws them back. The wiki gives no details of this spell, so this is an honest reading of its name.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_anvil: An anvil the size of a house is forged in the sky and let go. After 1 second it lands on the aimed point (up to 24 blocks) and crushes everything within 5 blocks for 24 damage, tosses it up, and weighs it down with Slowness IV and Burden II for 5 seconds. Once per 5 minutes.
nusmp.page.book_legion.pawn_march: Five pawns line up and march forward as one rank. They advance 8 blocks in a second; everyone they meet is hit once for 5 damage, shoved back and left in Slowness II for 2.5 seconds. The lead pawn stays standing at the end of the road for 10 seconds as a soldier you can swap with.
nusmp.page.book_legion.muster_soldiers: The mage raises a ring of soldiers around themselves and lets them guard. Four soldiers (more with high EP) stand 3 blocks out for 30 seconds; every half second each one cuts down enemies within 3 blocks for 2.5 damage and Slowness for 1.5 seconds. Each enemy is hit once per pulse.
nusmp.page.book_legion.knight_gambit: A knight moves as the piece does: two squares one way, three the other, then a charge. It rides in an L around the target and crashes into it for 11 damage, throwing it up and back and leaving Weakness and Fragility for 4 seconds. The knight stands beside the target for 15 seconds as a soldier you can swap with. Bosses take half damage.
nusmp.page.book_legion.soldier_snare: Three soldiers surround one enemy and grip it. A hard control (shares the control cooldown): the target is held under Slowness X and Weakness for up to 4 seconds (shortened for bosses and repeated holds) and takes 4 damage. The three pawns stay standing for 2 seconds longer.
nusmp.page.book_legion.commanders_banner: A banner goes up and the mage commands the field. For 30 seconds your melee blows deal 3 more damage, and you and every ally within 8 blocks gain Speed and Resistance for 20 seconds. A pawn stands guard beside the banner for 30 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_legion.rook_barricade: Rooks pile up into a wall of stone brick in front of the mage: five blocks wide and three high, vanishing after 10 seconds. You gain Resistance for 8 seconds and Absorption for 10 seconds, allies within 6 blocks gain Resistance, and two rooks stand at the ends of the wall for 15 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_legion.blink_castling: Castling, as the chess rule says: the mage and a soldier trade squares. You swap places with the soldier closest to where you look (1.5 to 48 blocks), the soldier takes your old spot, you gain Resistance III for a second, and every mob hunting you within 16 blocks loses its target. It cannot be cast with no soldiers standing.
nusmp.page.book_legion.gehenna_game: A round chessboard unfolds at the aim point and the pieces come to life. For 8 seconds, on a board 7 blocks wide, eight pieces circle the board, and every half second enemies near a piece take 3 damage and Slowness II; everyone on the board is held in Slowness for the whole game. The pieces count as soldiers you can swap with.
nusmp.page.book_legion.endless_dominatio: The mage's legion rises without end. Eight soldiers orbit you at 4 blocks for 15 seconds; every half second enemies within 3 blocks of a soldier take 4.5 damage and Slowness II, and every 3 seconds the soldiers lunge at the four nearest foes within 20 blocks for 7 damage each, with Fragility and Weakness for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_legion.end_empress: Every soldier you have stands together and merges into one colossus. After a moment's gathering it slams down at the aim point: everything within 8 blocks takes 16 damage plus 3 for each merged soldier (up to 8), is thrown up, and is left in Slowness III and Fragility for 5 seconds. The giant then stands for 8 seconds, stomping every second for 6 damage within 6 blocks. A daily spell, usable once per day.
nusmp.page.book_beast.spirit_beast_summo: A beast of living flame steps out of the grimoire: a spectral lion-wolf with a ragged flame mane. It runs at your side and pounces on the nearest hostile within 12 blocks, biting for 7 damage (scaled by EP) and slowing what it hits, for 20 to 30 s (longer with EP). From 3.5x EP a spirit bear joins it and from 6x a spirit rhino. Casting again calls the pack anew.
nusmp.page.book_beast.primal_beast_form: The beast inside breaks the surface. For 30 s fur, ears, a flaming tail and claws grow over you: Strength II, Speed II and your melee hits deal 4.5 extra damage (scaled by EP). Cast while sneaking it becomes the great-beast shape: a ghost beast head and shoulders hover over you, the bonus is 6 and you gain Resistance I. Signature page; the older Beast Form page stays as it was.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.ideal_closer_fi: A gauntlet of ruby and sapphire as big as a cart rises beside you, draws back in front of the foe you are looking at and punches it. The blow deals 14 damage and throws the foe back and slows it (Slowness III, 3 seconds); you can call it twice in 12 seconds, and the second one is a sapphire hammer-fist that deals 12 and also shoves everything within 3.4 blocks for 7. Damage, size and how long the gauntlet hovers scale with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.gem_plate_armou: Faceted red and blue corundum plates grow over your shoulders, chest, forearms and shins, and gem shards circle you. For 20 seconds you gain Resistance III and Strength, and every shard darts at the nearest hostile within 12 blocks, piercing everything in its path for 3.5 damage and Slowness II. A well-mastered grimoire (or a devil state) also grows a crystal crown and wings of shards; the shard count, damage and duration scale with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_key.gate_of_keys: A tall gate of violet stone and gold rises out of the ground ahead of you, its keyhole alight, and its doors swing open on a well of stolen magic. For 8 seconds (longer with more EP, up to half again) it turns to the nearest foe within 14 blocks and looses a bolt every half second for 4 damage (scales with your EP; bosses take half): fire (burning), ice (frozen and slowed), lightning (silenced and weakened) or wind (lifts the foe), and the element changes with each cast. Needs a foe within 16 blocks; a new gate replaces the old one.
nusmp.page.book_key.key_guard: Three great keys with gem-set bows leave the grimoire and circle you like a guard, and a golden-violet keyhole glows on your back with three small keys orbiting your body. For 15 seconds (longer with more EP, up to half again) each great key stabs the nearest foe within 12 blocks of you for 5 damage (scales with your EP; bosses take half), slows it (Slowness II, 1.2 seconds) and knocks it back a little. Needs a foe within 16 blocks; a new cast replaces the old guard.
